text.en:
The Batangas School of Fisheries at Nasugbu, Batangas is hereby named the APOLINARIO R.
APACIBLE SCHOOL OF FISHERIES.

This Decree shall take effect upon its promulgation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
